overallNotes: This submission compiles the definitions section §1.01 excerpt spanning 'Disposition Percentage' through 'EMU Legislation'. No independently operative permission/prohibition rules appear in this excerpt; all output is WireDefinition entries.

Disposition Percentage and ECF Percentage supply tiered-percentage formulas that are consumed by mandatory prepayment mechanics in Sections 2.09(b) and 2.09(c) respectively, both of which are outside this submission's scope (context regions for those sections were reviewed only to confirm how the percentages are used, per tool policy - no economics were compiled from them).

Several purely categorical/eligibility definitions (Disqualified Lenders, Disqualified Stock's core eligibility test, EEA-related terms, Eligible Assignee, Domestic Subsidiary, EMU Legislation) have no computable numeric formula; they are represented with a null calculationExpression and a faithful excerpt, consistent with the treatment of purely descriptive terms.

All 7 frozen inventory items were consumed via inventoryItemIds on the definitions that carry their values (Effective Date; Disposition Percentage x3; ECF Percentage default; Disqualified Stock 91-day period; Effective Yield 4-year amortization convention). Additional detected values not covered by inventory items (ECF Percentage's 25.0%/0.0% tiers and their 2.50:1.00/2.00:1.00 ratio thresholds) are nonetheless fully represented in ECF Percentage's calculationExpression.
